source_inspection.java: The checked PlantUML worktree is exactly 71806a23780b04a5ccde2f8ceb5121edad5eb711. SourceStringReader.outputImage exports the selected Diagram, and updateStatus classifies PSystemError/PSystemUnsupported as errors. The account's Java provenance is real, although the Rust gate recognizes Java error pages through the frozen SVG marker census rather than Java status objects.
source_inspection.rust: Inspected the full parity_evidence.rs normalizer and selector, its unit tests, the harness_guards integration, and the parity_perturbations shipped-path comparison loop. The selector reports 177 accepted held-outs at the pinned revision. The renderer comparison catches divergences, but the metadata/path normalizer has multiple false-accept paths and the selected corpus currently has 26 divergences.

account_aliases.finding: Field aliases are finite, but any account*.json filename is admitted and only literal account.json is directory-bound. Multiple or cross-directory legacy account records can therefore satisfy another directory's review by mechanism string.

reviewer_aliases.finding: The three required attestation dimensions need not come from one reviewer object. Top-level identity=Codex checker plus commands=[cargo test] supplies identity, model, and tool without explicit model/tool metadata.

verdict_spellings.finding: Verdict matching is closed and arbitrary prefixes are rejected. Result aliases are not conflict-closed: a pass in one alias and explicit fail/diverge in another still selects the item because generic fail/diverge text is not disqualifying.

revision_aliases.finding: Revision key names are finite, but the search recursively scans the entire review and accepts any 40 hexadecimal characters. It neither resolves the commit nor requires equality to the account, requested implementation, or Java revision; revisions embedded inside evidence satisfy attestation.

path_selection.finding: Parent and absolute lexical escapes are rejected. Canonical containment, mechanism-directory containment, same-stem pairing, and alias consistency are not enforced. Symlinks, cross-mechanism files, one golden reused by multiple sources, and a hidden escaping secondary alias all pass.

latest_selection.finding: Duplicate numeric sequences are rejected; latest rejected reviews correctly select nothing; later accepted reviews select again; pending accounts select nothing. Filename parsing is open-ended because review-<anything>-N.json maps to N and every other review-*.json falls back to sequence 1.

findings.title: Accepted attestation does not prove an independent checker or exact revisions
findings.evidence: Weak reviewer metadata, nonexistent hashes, and revisions nested inside held-out entries all pass and select evidence.

findings.title: Path selection can reuse unrelated evidence and escape through symlinks
findings.evidence: Cross-mechanism sources, non-same-stem goldens, hidden conflicting aliases, and symlink escapes all pass. The candidate deleted the previous canonicalize-and-containment check.

findings.title: Malformed and contradictory held-out semantics can satisfy acceptance
findings.evidence: Non-object entries are ignored, blank axes count as distinct, and pass plus fail/diverge aliases remain positive.

findings.title: Account and review filename/path normalization is not closed
findings.evidence: Arbitrary account*.json and review-*.json names are admitted; noncanonical records pair across directories by claimed mechanism.

findings.title: The pinned required gate commands are red
findings.evidence: The combined command fails the decimal ratchet, and the direct perturbation command reports 26 of 177 selected historical held-outs diverging from Java.

residue: The review did not alter the candidate to determine whether a hardened compatibility schema can still normalize every historical record.
The frozen Java-error classifier is marker-based; this review tested representative frozen markers and the 1,199 census, not every possible future PSystemError rendering.
Passing historical held-outs were inferred from the complete 177-case comparison's 26-item failure set; no comparator slack or selected artifact was changed.
verdict_reason: The shipped-path comparator correctly rejects divergent selected evidence and the verdict parser rejects arbitrary verdict prefixes, but the record gate can still accept fabricated reviewer/revision attestations, malformed or contradictory results, blank axes, open-ended record names, cross-mechanism/non-same-stem evidence, hidden conflicting aliases, and symlink path escapes. The pinned required test commands are also red. These are soundness counterexamples; the gate must be hardened rather than weakened.
